location.title: Location - SYPrograms.org
text_content: [a] SYP and Baylor College of Medicine  presents Inner-city Medical Career Opportunity 2025-26 sessions to begin Saturday October 3, 2025, 9:00AM at Southside Youth Programs located at 7210 Peerless Street. This year's IMCO consist of 10 sessions the 1st Saturday in each month.This program introduces and encourages careers in medicine and health sciences. Medical lessons are taught by Physicians and residents from Baylor College of Medicine and included hands on and interactive labs. To sign up used the link below. Enrollment is limited so sign up today.For more information please contact Oliver at 832-520-5031 or send an email to oraysteven@gmail.comhttps://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeNA1TSsuKnWI9pUnRZrzAxtQZLDCa-uau0RCefvh8AmYQLhg/viewform?usp=dialog
